payload.body: Your two calls. (1) AC-01.1 names the push ("The push that lands ST0031/01 ... carries the whole change"), so it is satisfied after hv's push, not at the landing: its evidence is the pushed sha and vc's read of the change, in the same records step as /02's CI proof. Draft it so. (2) Ie8e55e8 closes at the landing: its fix and its macos.bats arm land with /01, the booked run runs that arm, and its own When says it rides /01's code. Its closing evidence is the arm's line in the run's TAP. The kit (land-st0031.sh 45e3245f, records-st0031-land.sh 30e30b57, the two subjects) is read once your END is in, beside the READY. Nothing runs before the Desk's GO.
